title: Telemetry block
description: The machine-readable definition of docs/PIPELINE-CONTRACT.md §4 — the single fenced JSON object a session posts as a ticket comment to report itself. The `schema` key is the marker a collector scans for; the fence info string is plain `json` so it renders everywhere.
$comment: AGENT-AUTHORED ⇒ REPORTING ONLY. Conformance to this schema says the block is well formed. It says nothing about whether the numbers are true, and NOTHING here may ever gate a budget, an approval or a merge. The session_mode → stage table in §4 is a cross-field consistency check the collector performs; a schema cannot express it.

schema.description: The marker. A collector keeps the objects carrying exactly this value and ignores every other json fence in the comment.

runs.description: One row per run. Rows are idempotent on run_id — re-posting the same block must not double-count. One telemetry block per comment (§4, §8).

ticket_events.description: Zero or more append-only facts. The same (ticket_id, event, at) posted twice is one event.

review_findings.description: Optional; a review-stage run may carry what it found alongside what it cost. Mirrors the pipeline-review/1 finding shape so there is one finding shape in the system, not two.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC with a literal Z.

counter.description: A non-negative integer. Never null — 0 is how 'not used' is reported.

run_id.description: Globally unique, opaque; recommended r_ + ULID. Stable across re-posts — it is the idempotency key.

dispatch_id.description: OPTIONAL. The pin's dispatch_id (§3), which is the second side of that join. Null for a run with no pin (a manual /work).

session_mode.description: OPTIONAL. The pinned mode this run believes it was dispatched under — a SELF-REPORT of a pinned value, so it flags contract conformance and grants nothing. Present ⇒ the collector can run the §4 mode/stage cross-check.

ticket_id.description: e.g. ENG-123. Null for runs with no ticket.

stage.description: What kind of work this run did. Must sit inside the pinned session_mode's allowed set (§4) — checked by the collector, not here.

ended_at.description: Null only for an in-flight row; a POSTED block should be terminal.

tokens_cache_read.description: 0 when caching was not used — never null.

tokens_cache_write.description: 0 when caching was not used — never null.

cost_usd.description: Best-effort self-report, up to 4 decimal places. Dashboards only — spend is metered by the dispatcher, and a session that under-reports must not be able to buy itself more budget (§1).

outcome.description: capacity = provider capacity; budget = a cap in budgets stopped it; blocked = needs a human decision.

error_class.description: Short stable slug, e.g. rate_limit, hook_block, ci_red. Null unless outcome is one of blocked/error/timeout/capacity/budget — a cross-field rule the collector checks.

actor.description: system = CI, a webhook, a cron. `merged` is always human or system — never agent.

reviewFinding.description: Findings carry no ID: a collector keys them on a digest of their own content (§10), so a re-posted block collapses onto one row while two genuinely different findings on the same line stay two.

category.description: correctness, security, tests, scope. Free-form beyond those, and grouped as-is by dashboards.

pr_number.description: Defaults to the PR named by the block's runs row.

at.description: Defaults to the comment's own timestamp.
